[SUBJECT] Elegant beauty-salon promo: rose-gold styling tools, silk ribbons, dried flowers and a vanity mirror on a blush marble surface; no faces.
[TYPOGRAPHY] Service as headline. Arabic typography reads «{{service}}» exactly as written: correctly shaped, connected Arabic letters, right-to-left, no Latin letters, no extra words.{{#if offer}} Offer line reads «{{offer}}», same Arabic typography rules.{{/if}}{{#if brand}} Business name «{{brand}}» at the bottom in a smaller weight, same Arabic typography rules.{{/if}}
[STYLE] blush pink, cream and rose-gold palette, soft and luxurious.
[AVOID] warped Arabic letters, English text, watermark.

templates.desc_en: A square post for a promo code or free shipping
templates.prompt:
[SUBJECT] Bold e-commerce promo tile: a stylized delivery box with motion lines and floating shopping icons on a solid vibrant background.
[TYPOGRAPHY] Headline very large. Arabic typography reads «{{headline}}» exactly as written: correctly shaped, connected Arabic letters, right-to-left, no Latin letters, no extra words.{{#if code}} A ticket-shaped badge reads «{{code}}» exactly (Latin characters allowed only inside this badge).{{/if}}{{#if brand}} Business name «{{brand}}» at the bottom in a smaller weight, same Arabic typography rules.{{/if}}
[STYLE] vibrant blue and lime palette, flat 3D style, extremely legible at small sizes.
[AVOID] warped Arabic letters, extra text, watermark.

templates.desc_en: A post with three numbered reasons on your topic
templates.prompt:
[SUBJECT] Clean educational social post with a headline and three numbered rows with simple icons.
[TYPOGRAPHY] Headline at the top. Arabic typography reads «{{title}}» exactly as written: correctly shaped, connected Arabic letters, right-to-left, no Latin letters, no extra words. Row 1 reads «{{r1}}», row 2 reads «{{r2}}», row 3 reads «{{r3}}», each preceded by a large numeral, same Arabic typography rules, aligned right.
[STYLE] white card on a soft colored background, generous spacing, modern infographic style.
[AVOID] warped Arabic letters, English text, extra rows, watermark.

templates.desc_en: An eye-catching vertical reel cover with a big title

fields.default: a modern home office desk with a laptop and coffee

templates.prompt:
[SUBJECT] Vertical reel cover: background photo of {{scene}}, slightly blurred and darkened for contrast.
[TYPOGRAPHY] Big bold title in the middle third, inside a high-contrast highlight box. Arabic typography reads «{{title}}» exactly as written: correctly shaped, connected Arabic letters, right-to-left, no Latin letters, no extra words. Keep top and bottom 15% clear for app UI.
[STYLE] bold creator style, strong contrast, one accent color.
[AVOID] warped Arabic letters, English text, faces, watermark.
